title: Choose Thaalam's visual world
question: The roll dealt Fridge Door. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Fridge Door
options.lineage: the shared kitchen fridge: photos held up by chunky plastic alphabet magnets
options.thesis: The canvas is the fridge door everyone sticks things to; each photo hangs from a magnet in its role colour, and the magnet bounces on its notes.
options.viewport: Phone: scattered, slightly tilted photo cards on a mint enamel field, each pinned by a role-coloured magnet; the multicolour 'thaalam' wordmark is spelled in alphabet magnets top-left; a bottom bar holds Play, Add photo and Invite.
options.risk: Tips into kiddie if the magnets get cute faces or the type gets bubbly; the magnet must stay a clean functional pin that carries role and mute.

raised.raise: Every card keeps one exact size and one ground; play, mute and listening never resize a card.
State lives on the object: role colour and mute sit on the card's own magnet, with no separate legend or panel.
A tempo or scale change holds its highlight in the status chip until someone notices it.
One unit drives everything: card, magnet, bar height and spacing all derive from the same base step.
Motion comes only from the audio clock; nothing moves decoratively, and reduced motion holds a still.

options.label: Party Table Prints
options.lineage: photo-booth strips and instant prints tossed across a party table
options.thesis: Photos land like prints dropped on a hot-pink party table, flash-white borders, overlapping at angles, glowing in their own colours when they play.
options.viewport: Phone: a hot-pink tabletop with tilted white-bordered prints, handwritten-style role labels on each print's bottom margin, and a bottom bar with Play, Add photo and Invite.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs land on for scattered photos: polaroids on a table is the literal reading of the brief.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.lineage: flat Metro tiles and giant cropped lowercase
options.thesis: Cards become flat photo tiles on black with giant lowercase role words; a playing card floods its role colour, chrome deleted.
options.viewport: Phone: black ground, 'thaalam' cropped off the right edge in giant lowercase, photo tiles scattered with role words in flat colour, accent floods the selected tile.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on product clarity: tiles carry role and state with no chrome. Loses audience identification; the black ground reads cooler than a bright, playful jam.
options.risk: Reads as Windows Phone nostalgia, and the black ground fights the brief's 'bright'.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.lineage: boarding passes and a live departures board
options.thesis: Cards as segmented passes, the mix as a gate board that reranks parts.
options.viewport: A ranked board of parts over a stack of passes.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a ranked list contradicts the scattered mess, and travel admin isn't play.
options.kept: A change holds its highlight until noticed.
options.risk: Turns a jam into an airport.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Each photo as a plate at one exact scale.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cream and sepia contradict bright and playful; aligned plates contradict the mess.
options.kept: One exact scale and ground for every item.

options.label: Convention Catalog
options.lineage: newsprint circle catalogs marked in biro
options.thesis: Photos packed as stamp-size cells, circled when playing.
options.viewport: A dense numbered grid of thumbnails.
options.case: Fuses poorly: single-ink newsprint isn't bright, and a packed grid isn't a mess.
options.kept: State is marked on the object itself.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Cards snap to a visible construction grid.
options.viewport: A visible grid with cards in cells.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a visible grid is the opposite of the unorganized mess you asked for.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: The mix as strobing barcode fields.
options.case: Fuses poorly: pure black and white rules out bright colour, and strobing isn't friendly.
options.kept: Motion driven only by the signal, still under reduced motion.
options.risk: Cold and hard on the eyes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A bright, flat music-toy canvas in the Chrome Music Lab mould, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Phone: white canvas, rounded photo cards with coloured role chips, a big round play button at the bottom centre.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other music toys by design.
